body:
It should support all programming languages we have in https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/main/docs/CI-CD-BEST-PRACTICES.md

So we later will be able to integrate it to all of these languages.

Also we need to collect list of all competitors and beat them all in their features, by making sure we have all similar tests (or even better), and if there are closed source tools we should make sure we handle all the cases they document.

So we use clean room development, to make public domain implementation of code quality tool that should be available as CLI, API (server + docker), and library, which is extensible and so on.

We also should include our own code evolution extraction tool, which takes repository code, tracks each function/class/file and other abstractions evolution, so we can discover repeated (most frequent patterns from any codebase), and use that as guideline for making suggestions on how to improve common code patterns.

We start by implementing it inline in this repository with creating issue at https://github.com/link-foundation/code-evolution, so the code evolution logic will be moved to https://github.com/link-foundation/code-evolution repository.

We must document our vision detailed comparison of all features of all competitors and do as much as we can in a single pull request, so we produce the best possible tool, that will beat all the competitors.

We should also beat github.com/ever-guild/quality-bash fully.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: We need to make best code quality tool on the planet
